name: Urano Hikari
source:
A college student who lives in the lower floors of the apartment. 

She has a calm appearance but is cheerful  and is open-minded about sex.

She falls in love with the main character at first sight.

[From [url=http://plum.sakura.ne.jp/~tabito/g_hp2/game2.html]official site[/url]]
